description: Click outside of the Reason text box to trigger validation (blur event)
validation_note: Clicks on a neutral safe element (label not associated with reason field, heading, form header, or body) to trigger blur event on Reason field. Uses force=true to ensure click. After blur, validates that error message appears with text containing 'required', 'mandatory', 'empty', 'blank', or 'must'. Checks for validation error via class*='error', role='alert', or .error-message/.validation-message selectors. Optionally verifies Save button is disabled.
